message.content:
The full quote is **“Businesses owned by responsible and organized merchants shall eventually surpass those owned by wealthy rulers.”** It is attributed to **Ibn Khaldun** in the *Muqaddimah*[1][2].

If you want, I can also help with the **meaning** of the quote or its **historical context**.
